body.message:
Hi Tharushi, thank you for reaching out.

We are a rental agency, Aura Stay Holiday Homes, specially working with properties in Peninsula and Business Bay. We currently have multiple clients looking for properties in these areas and are looking to rent them out ASAP.

Do you have any vacant properties available in Peninsula or Business Bay that you would like to rent out? We’d be happy to collaborate and bring you genuine clients.

We charge the commission from the client, and the commission can be split between us as part of the collaboration.

Looking forward to working together!
